name: Centrifugal oil filter
function: Removes fine contaminants from lubricating oil by centrifugal separation.
location: Oil-cleaning branch of the lubricating oil circuit
maintenance: Clean the rotor and housing, inspect seals and confirm that the rotor turns freely.

name: Automatic backwash filter
function: Continuously filters lubricating oil and automatically clears accumulated debris from the filter elements.
maintenance: Monitor differential pressure and backwash operation; inspect filter elements, valves and drain connections.

name: Lubricating oil filter fitting
function: Connects the filter assembly to the lubricating oil piping and maintains a sealed flow path.
location: At the lubricating oil filter connections
maintenance: Inspect joints, fasteners and seals for looseness, damage or oil leakage.

name: Lubricating oil pump
function: Circulates lubricating oil through the engine at the pressure and flow needed to protect moving parts.
location: Supply side of the lubricating oil circuit
maintenance: Check delivery pressure, noise, vibration, coupling condition and seals for leakage.

name: Lubricating oil pump piping
function: Routes lubricating oil between the pump, filters, cooler and engine oil galleries.
location: Around the lubricating oil pump and treatment equipment
maintenance: Inspect pipes, supports, flanges and flexible connections for leakage, corrosion or vibration damage.

name: Lubricating oil thermostatic valve
function: Regulates oil flow through the cooler to maintain the required lubricating oil temperature.
location: At the lubricating oil cooler bypass junction
maintenance: Verify the opening temperature and movement; inspect the valve element and seals for sticking or leakage.

name: Plate heat exchanger
function: Transfers heat from the lubricating oil to the cooling medium without mixing the fluids.
location: Cooling section of the lubricating oil circuit
maintenance: Check temperatures and pressure drop; inspect plates, gaskets and connections for fouling or leakage.
